decisive_finding.cause: A regular-directory ancestor substituted at OpenDirectory is adopted as trusted. At the later Rename boundary it can be relocated outside while the original ancestor is restored; descriptor-relative rename_swap then mutates the relocated outside directory before post-effect identity checking reports ObjectChanged.
decisive_finding.scope: Broader than the disclosed fstatat-to-unlinkat interval; the escape occurs at rename_swap and post-effect detection cannot undo the outside mutation.

corrective_action: Redesign the write path so an ancestor adopted from a substituted name can never become a mutation authority after relocation. Add the exact chained OpenDirectory-plus-Rename probe to the owned contract suite, preserve outside bytes on every rejected path, and re-review the entire corrected 70-artifact distribution boundary. If the supported POSIX host cannot enforce that property against an actor with rename authority, fail closed or lower the product contract through root authority; do not hide the assumption as an unlink-only residual.
claim_ceiling: The distribution source remains an unaccepted corrective candidate. Source/package/install/cache/marketplace/app-registry/Plugins UI/discovery/runtime, node closure, readiness, release, and completion remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This decision records one decisive outside-write defect and stops broader review. It does not accept or integrate the candidate.
